42137.explanation: Commercial peppercorn dressing is safe with precautions during pregnancy as a commercially bottled sauce. 42138.explanation: Cholesterol-free reduced-calorie mayonnaise is safe with precautions during pregnancy as a shelf-stable condiment. 42178.explanation: Tofu-based mayonnaise is safe with precautions during pregnancy as an egg-free plant condiment. Prioritize less-processed, heart-healthy liquid oils for your daily home cooking.

04659.explanation: Industrial coconut confection fat should be limited during pregnancy because of its extreme saturated fat density.
